answer: The strongest lever is simple: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because pigment only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, forge is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any vertex approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
